technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with volume confirmation and bullish structure, but overbought conditions and price below longer-term moving averages create pullback risk; moderate swing entry with elevated caution.

fundamental.summary: CHD shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 35 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (15/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale (218+ days old) with mixed signals and no recent conviction; neutral to weak setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with VIX in crisis territory (370), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar headwind, and elevated credit stress create highly unfavourable conditions; earnings in 35 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term momentum (vol_spike_15x, hull_flip_up, three_white_soldiers, ADX trending, supertrend bullish) with volume confirmation and extreme fear sentiment (15/100) creating contrarian buy opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis at 370, flat yield curve, rising credit spreads, strong dollar), overbought oscillators (stoch, williams_r, stochrsi), price below all key moving averages (9/21/50/200 EMAs and SMAs), zero fundamental support, and earnings event risk in 35 days overwhelm technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Strong short-term momentum (vol spike, hull flip, three white soldiers) and extreme fear sentiment (15/100) create contrarian appeal, but macro environment is severely deteriorated and fundamental support is absent.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (370), flat yield curve, elevated credit spreads, and rising dollar create macro headwinds that will likely overwhelm technical strength; earnings in 35 days adds event risk to an already overbought setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
